_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which model/provider each agent uses. Change models HERE only — rule books never name a model. Set {{OWNER_CHAT_ID}} and {{REPORT_HOUR}} when bootstrapping a new project.
_auto_merge: When true, merge-on-green squash-merges the PR once reviewer+CI+isolation+security are green. DEFAULT false (open PR + stop) until proven in your env.

webhook_receiver._comment: Inbound GitHub webhooks. Set secret to match your GitHub webhook configuration.

github._comment: GitHub API token for reading CI logs and posting PR comments.

coverage_floors._comment: Minimum coverage % required for Gate 3 (ProvingGround) to pass. Floors sit ~2pt below actuals — never bump same-PR.

gate_timeout._comment: Iron Funnel gate duration thresholds. Warn/escalate written to DecisionLog (Telegram in Phase 06).

speed_gates._comment: Speed pipeline gates — schema gate skipped (design agent handles schema inline); UI gate kept; review gate kept.

reporting._comment: Morning report sent from each developer's machine to owner_chat_id at report_hour:00.

triage._role: Upstream router only — classifies tier (1/2/3). Hard 4k token limit. Haiku: cheapest correct option for pure classification.

reframe._role: Premise challenger — classification + reading-comprehension + YAML formatting. Sonnet is sufficient; heavy reasoning overkill here. Save Opus for reviewer/debugger/plan where deep semantic reasoning matters.

question._role: Generates clarifying questions and Q-anchors. Sonnet handles the cross-reference invariants well.

research._role: RAG routing + citation extraction with strict schema (RS1-RS18). Sonnet: can simultaneously hold verbatim Q-anchors + file:line evidence + exact frontmatter field names.

design._role: Architecture design + DB schema + API contracts. Sonnet produces solid design artifacts at lower cost.

design-critic._role: Specialized design check. MUST be a different model family than 'design' so it is not grading its own homework.

integrator._role: Bidirectional integration enforcement + registry lookup + blast-radius analysis. Deep semantic reasoning required — Opus.

plan._role: Produces 5-plan.json + task files. Multi-axis dependency graph + archetype classification — Opus.

frontend._role: Frontend code generation. Sonnet produces high-quality React/TS code and follows component rules reliably.

backend._role: Backend code generation. Sonnet handles CQRS + migration tripod patterns well.

test-writer._role: Writes tests AFTER the coders. VALIDATED: Haiku fails test-writing — cannot hold fixture patterns, assertion libraries, and coverage invariants simultaneously. Sonnet required. i8 cross-model check: reviewer (Opus) audits test-writer (Sonnet) — different families, invariant satisfied.

debugger._role: Root-cause diagnosis on failing gates. Deep reasoning on error logs + vision + code — Opus.

reviewer._role: PR review: registry duplication check + security rubric + bidirectional wiring + compliance gate. Opus for the highest-stakes gate.

tech-writer._role: Post-merge doc distillation + lessons loop. Sonnet handles doc authoring and rule-book updates well.

surveyor._role: Proactive backlog audit + ranked proposals (nightly). Multi-axis reasoning (impact × urgency × phase-dependency × compliance-gap × blast-radius) — Opus. MUST be a different model family than 'reframe' so surveyor proposals are not subject to the same blind spots as the reframe that later processes them.

speed_roles._comment: 5-agent speed pipeline (design → frontend → backend → test-writer → reviewer). Mirrors Soltan-babysitter/front/backend/push flow. 1 UI gate only — schema gate disabled by default.

design._role: Speed-pipeline combined design+plan agent. Does the work of 6 full-pipeline agents in one pass — needs Opus for deep reasoning on scope, schema, API contract, and plan generation simultaneously.

frontend._role: Frontend code generation. Identical to full pipeline role.

backend._role: Backend code generation. Identical to full pipeline role.

test-writer._role: Writes tests after builders. VALIDATED: Haiku fails test-writing. Sonnet required. i8: reviewer (Opus) audits test-writer (Sonnet) — different families, invariant satisfied.

reviewer._role: PR review: design conformance + security rubric + registry duplication. Highest-stakes gate — Opus. Must differ from builder model family.

subq._note: Premium Gate 5 provider. Opt-in via roles.orchestrator.provider = subq. Bypasses context slicing — feeds full repo AST + PR diff (up to 12M tokens) for holistic semantic review.
